source_title: Quins claim victory at Exeter in nine-try nailbiter
source_excerpt:
Cadan Murley (right) scored the first of Quins five tries as they triumphed over Exeter at Sandy Park
Tries: Wilson, Abuladze, Butt, Woodburn Cons: Slade 4
Tries: Murley, David, Schmid 2, Kenningham Cons: Smith 3
Harlequins secured back-to-back Prem victories for the first time this season, defeating Exeter Chiefs in an enthralling end-to-end contest at Sandy Park.
Quins dominated the opening exchanges, with Cadan Murley and Nick David going over before Chiefs responded through Harry Wilson's close-range effort.
Efforts from Nika Abuladze and Will Butt either side of half-time put the home side ahead but Quins fought their way back into the lead after a quick-fire brace from Lucas Schmid.
Jack Kenningham and Olly Woodburn exchanged late tries to set up a tense finish but Quins managed to scramble the ball into touch and ensure their winning run continues.
Under a bright Devon sky, it was the visitors who struck first.
Following a knock-on from the returning Manny Feyi-Waboso, Murley fed George Furbank who powered up the wing. The ball was then passed inside to Marcus Smith who fed the onrushing Murley to go over.
Quins doubled that lead soon afterwards. Attacking in the Chiefs' 22, Luke Northmore's delayed run unlocked the home defence, the centre then feeding the returning David to score despite the efforts of Woodburn.
The Chiefs, struggling to take advantage of their opportunities, finally got points on the board through Wilson, the lock driving over from a quick pick-and-go after good work from Abuladze.
Despite having a man advantage following Bryn Bradley's yellow card, the home side were repeatedly denied by aggressive Quins defending before eventually fighting their way over through Abuladze to even the scores on the verge of half-time.
Will Butt's effort put the Chiefs ahead, but the home side were unable to maintain that lead in the second-half
After all their good defensive work in the first-half, Quins then went behind thanks to a missed tackle. Marcus Smith was unable to contain Butt in midfield, with the centre scampering up the pitch to add the Chiefs' third.
Schmid's close-range effort restored parity, with the number eight then capitalising minutes later to add another.
Following strong carrying from Sam Riley and Luke Northmore, Quins drove into the Chiefs' 22. With the ball eventually recycled wide, the back-rower drove through the final defenders to score in the corner.
Following late tries for Kenningham and Woodburn, the Chiefs found themselves only three points behind, but with the clock in the red they lost the ball at the lineout allowing Quins to kick for touch to record only their second league victory of the season.
Exeter: Haydon-Wood; Feyi-Waboso, Slade, Butt, Woodburn; Skinner, Varney; Abuladze, Yeandle (c), Iosefa-Scott; Pearson, Wilson, Roots, Vintcent, Fisilau.
Replacements: Norey, Goodrick-Clarke, Tchumbadze, Bailey, James, Wolstenholme, Hammersley, Wimbush.
Harlequins: Furbank; David, Northmore, Bradley, Murley (c); Smith, Porter; Baxter, Walker, Kerrod; Dun, Treadwell, Kenningham, Driscoll, Schmid.
Replacements: Riley, Hobson, Streeter, Williams, Browne, Evans, Friday, Isgro.

## रोमांचक मैच में हर्लेक्विंस की जीत

हालिया रग्बी मुकाबले में हर्लेक्विंस (Harlequins) ने सैंडी पार्क (Sandy Park) में खेले गए मैच में एक्सेटर चीफ्स (Exeter Chiefs) के खिलाफ रोमांचक जीत हासिल की है। यह मुकाबला दोनों टीमों के बीच काफी संघर्षपूर्ण रहा, जिसमें कुल नौ ट्राई (Tries) देखने को मिले। इस जीत के साथ हर्लेक्विंस ने इस सीज़न में पहली बार लगातार दो प्रेमियर मुकाबले अपने नाम किए हैं।

## मैच के मुख्य आकर्षण

मैच की शुरुआत से ही दोनों टीमों ने आक्रामक खेल का प्रदर्शन किया। मुकाबला के मुख्य बिंदु इस प्रकार हैं:

* **शुरुआती बढ़त:** हर्लेक्विंस के लिए कैडन मर्ले (Cadan Murley) और निक डेविड (Nick David) ने शुरुआती प्रयास किए, जिससे मेहमान टीम ने बढ़त बनाई।
* **एक्सेटर की वापसी:** चीफ्स की ओर से हैरी विल्सन (Harry Wilson), निका अबूलेद्जे (Nika Abuladze) और विल बट (Will Butt) ने शानदार प्रदर्शन करते हुए स्कोर को आगे बढ़ाया और टीम को बढ़त दिलाई।
* **निर्णायक मोड़:** मैच के दूसरे हाफ में लुकास श्मिड (Lucas Schmid) ने दो बार ट्राई करके हर्लेक्विंस को फिर से मुकाबले में आगे कर दिया।

## रोमांचक अंत

खेल के अंतिम क्षणों में जैक केनिंगहैम (Jack Kenningham) और ओली वुडबर्न (Olly Woodburn) ने ट्राई करके अंतर को केवल तीन अंकों का कर दिया था। हालांकि, समय समाप्त होने के करीब एक्सेटर की टीम लाइनआउट पर गेंद संभाल नहीं पाई, जिसका फायदा उठाकर हर्लेक्विंस ने गेंद को टच लाइन से बाहर कर अपनी जीत सुनिश्चित कर ली।

## आगे की जानकारी के लिए सत्यापन

इस मैच से जुड़ी आधिकारिक पुष्टि, स्कोरकार्ड और अधिक विस्तृत जानकारी के लिए रग्बी यूनियन के आधिकारिक स्पोर्ट्स पोर्टल और संबंधित क्लबों की घोषणाओं को देखा जा सकता है।

en_body:
## Harlequins Claim Consecutive League Wins

Harlequins secured back-to-back Premiership victories for the first time this season following a hard-fought win against Exeter Chiefs at Sandy Park. The high-scoring encounter featured nine tries in total, culminating in a tense finish that ultimately favored the visitors.

According to match reports, Harlequins started strongly under clear conditions in Devon, establishing an early lead before the hosts mounted a sustained comeback.

## Match Breakdown and Scoring

* **Early Visitors' Advantage:** Cadan Murley opened the scoring for Harlequins, finishing off a move initiated by George Furbank and Marcus Smith. Nick David soon extended the lead to put the visitors firmly ahead in the opening exchanges.
* **Exeter Fightback:** The Chiefs responded through a close-range try by lock Harry Wilson. Despite a yellow card shown to Harlequins' Bryn Bradley, Exeter capitalized on the numerical advantage just before half-time when Nika Abuladze crossed the line to level the score.
* **Lead Changes:** Will Butt put the hosts ahead shortly after the break following a missed tackle in midfield. However, Harlequins reclaimed momentum through a quick-fire brace from number eight Lucas Schmid, who scored two close-range tries.
* **Tense Conclusion:** Late scores from Jack Kenningham for Harlequins and Olly Woodburn for Exeter narrowed the gap to three points. With the clock in the red, Exeter lost possession at a crucial lineout, allowing Harlequins to kick the ball into touch and seal the victory.

## Practical Implications and Verification

With this result, Harlequins continue their winning run in the league, while Exeter Chiefs reflect on missed opportunities despite a competitive display featuring tries from Wilson, Abuladze, Butt, and Woodburn alongside four conversions by Henry Slade. Harlequins' scoring efforts included tries from Murley, David, Schmid (2), and Kenningham, with three conversions added by Marcus Smith.

Readers wishing to verify the official match statistics, lineups, and league standings can consult the official Premiership Rugby website or verified sports broadcast networks reporting on the competition.
